text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I'd like this yokan dessert,
please.

text_block_list.name: Candy Store Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. It's rare to see you buying
confectionery,
Yaeno. Is this a gift for
someone?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, I just thought I'd buy some for
myself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I don't usually go for sweet snacks, but
for some
reason I have an irresistible
craving right now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's possible that Yaeno Muteki is still
fatigued
from her recent races. It looks
like I'll probably
need to rethink her
upcoming race schedule.
